research_question: Does author sparse NVFP4 plus full dense FP4 residual improve error and total Wan FFN cost versus same-W native dense FP4 and original BF16?

hypotheses_with_opposing_predictions.prediction: Two-branch quantization improves fidelity with worthwhile total FFN latency.
hypotheses_with_opposing_predictions.discriminator: Same-encoding numerical tests, original-BF16 error and whole-FFN timings.

hypotheses_with_opposing_predictions.prediction: Residual/preparation cost removes sparse speedup despite a fast sparse branch.
hypotheses_with_opposing_predictions.discriminator: Same-W dense32 total latency versus SharQ total, including both W1/W2 and both branches.

adversarial_counterexample: A wrong scale/packed layout can remain finite, and per-operation events can distort a two-branch speed comparison; M31668 may be unsupported.
